usedFor: Everyone who books on Calendly lands in HubSpot as a new or updated contact.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It matches on email, so a repeat booker updates the existing contact instead of duplicating it.

watchOut: “Invitee Canceled” also fires “Create or Update Contact”, so a cancel and a booking touch the same contact.
